function: Excluded (function): the learned speed predictor and MLP estimate water level and its variation speed from RSRP, i.e. sensing; beams are fixed steering vectors, not learned (p. 2-3).
notes: Excluded for function. The learned parts only estimate water level and its speed from RSRP: p. 3: "We propose a novel DL model to train the pre-processed signals with suppressing the interference paths and estimate the water level". Beams are not learned: p. 2: "we use steering vectors to determine fS and fC". The experiment is sensing only: p. 4: "The beam scanning function δS (t) equals 1 constantly". Reported results are RMSE of height and speed only (p. 5), with no communication metric. Borderline: the letter is framed as ISAC with time-division sensing and communication beams (p. 2); if the reviewer counts that framing as area 5, the decision changes.
